physics-killer-04.title: Kubad ayaa si jiif
physics-killer-04.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-04.material: Kubad ayaa si jiif ah looga tuuray cidhifka dhagax $20\\,\\mathrm{m}$ dherer ah oo ku dhacday dhulka masaafo jiif ah oo $30\\,\\mathrm{m}$ ah laga bilaabo dhagaxa. Isticmaal $g=10\\,\\mathrm{m/s^2}$ oo iska dhaaf iska caabinta hawada. Doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa, si kala horreeya, xawaaraha kubadda daqiiqadda ay gaadho dhulka iyo $\\theta$, halkaas oo $\\tan\\theta$ yahay xagalka xawaarahaas la sameeyo jiifka daqiiqaddaas?
physics-killer-04.s.s1.prompt: Kubad ayaa si jiif ah looga tuuray cidhifka dhagax $20\\,\\mathrm{m}$ dherer ah oo ku dhacday dhulka masaafo jiif ah oo $30\\,\\mathrm{m}$ ah laga bilaabo dhagaxa. Isticmaal $g=10\\,\\mathrm{m/s^2}$ oo iska dhaaf iska caabinta hawada. Doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa, si kala horreeya, xawaaraha kubadda daqiiqadda ay gaadho dhulka iyo $\\theta$, halkaas oo $\\tan\\theta$ yahay xagalka xawaarahaas la sameeyo jiifka daqiiqaddaas?
physics-killer-04.s.s1.explain: Si toosan $20=\frac12\cdot10\cdot t^2\Rightarrow t=2\,\mathrm{s}$. Si jiif ah $30=v_0t\Rightarrow v_0=15\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Wax yar ka hor dhulka gaadhista $v_y=gt=20\,\mathrm{m/s}$. $v=\sqrt{15^2+20^2}=25\,\mathrm{m/s}$, $\tan\theta=\dfrac{v_y}{v_0}=\dfrac{20}{15}=\dfrac43$. Ku darista qaybaha sida $v_0+gt=35$ waxay bixisaa doodda 1; qorista $\tan\theta$ ka rogan waxay bixisaa $\frac34$ (doodda 2); isticmaalka qaybta toosan ee $20\,\mathrm{m/s}$ oo keliya sida xawaaraha waxay bixisaa doodda 4.
physics-killer-04.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-04.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
